name: Apex Converting & Packaging
old_description: At Apex Converting & Packaging, we are a trusted leader in the industrial packaging industry, providing a comprehensive range of high-quality packaging solutions. With a focus on excellence and customer satisfaction, we serve as a reliable partner for distributors nationwide. Our expertise lies in converting and supplying top-notch packaging products, ensuring that businesses can ship their products securely and efficiently.
about:
Apex Converting & Packaging is based in Charlotte, North Carolina. The company's founding year and ownership structure have not been publicly disclosed. It operates as a converter and supplier of industrial packaging materials.

The company converts and supplies a comprehensive line of packaging products, including banding film, extended-core stretch film, full-gauge-equivalent film, colored film, adhesive tape, plastic strapping, conventional stretch film, and strapping tools. Its converting capabilities enable custom slitting, rewinding, and packaging configurations tailored to distributor requirements. No facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures are published.

Apex serves distributors nationwide across the industrial packaging sector. Its customer base includes wholesale distributors who resell packaging supplies to end users in manufacturing, warehousing, and shipping operations. The company positions itself as a partner for distributors seeking reliable supply and technical support.

The company differentiates itself through a consultative approach, competitive pricing, and customized solutions. Its stated core values—reliability, integrity, customer focus, innovation, and collaboration—guide its interactions, with a stated mission to deliver affordable, reliable packaging supplies that help clients optimize their operations.
